title: Characterize a late sample with an older timestamp
reason: Reviewed non-promoting characterization/design; excluded from the 461 assertion-bearing case credit; source retained.

contract.intent: Characterize a late sample with an older timestamp
contract.failure_hypothesis: A reader could mistake monotonic clock clamping for rejection of stale load payloads
preconditions: Fresh State::new("fixture", config()) per case; only production on_event transitions; no direct State-field mutation
Each resident created by RequestAt -> absent OwnerRead -> Applied epoch1 CAS -> RestoreCompleted -> RuntimeStarted generation1 -> Published; exact operation IDs come from effects
Every transition invokes State::validate; occupied<=4, activating<=4, evicting<=2; local completions tracked exactly once
Default require_node_lease=false isolates admission from fleet authority; this does not exercise actual lease authorization
Pressure samples are synthetic byte-valued facts, not measured RSS, allocator, cgroup or container enforcement
The immutable source/runtime-manifest pins and exact implementation must pass preflight before any authorized future run
contract.initial_state: empty node; high load arrives with monotonic timestamp120
trace: observe low payload clears shedding and emits a CAS
contract.stress: Finite ordered schedule <=100 State events, <=4 occupied cells, <=4 activation permits, <=2 eviction/release permits; no randomness, seeds, size grid or repetition multiplier
contract.safety_oracle: Pinned source folds older payload and admits; this is not a freshness safety guarantee
contract.liveness_oracle: a completes Local on the captured CAS emitted by older payload
contract.oracle: Pinned source folds older payload and admits; this is not a freshness safety guarantee; a completes Local on the captured CAS emitted by older payload
contract.terminal_witness: TRACE_END P010 after exact outcomes, pending=0, no active requests or transition permits, and production validation
contract.cleanup: Finish every successful local request; settle all emitted stop/release/adoption effects shown by the trace; assert pending demand and activation/eviction/release/adoption counts empty. Drop owned in-memory State on return/unwind. No external resource created
contract.qualification: Source behavior only; four characterization cases cannot become general freshness/health/liveness guarantees
